strings.Все люди, документы и события этого дела: All people, documents and events in this case are fictional. The materials concern an ordinary public building with no special regime. Exit Э-5 is designated as an evacuation exit on the plan. The specialist’s initial record states that a key was required to open Э-5 from inside. The subsequent remedial-action report concerns Э-4. That report does not confirm the current condition of Э-5. No current fire or smoke is reported; the citizen is not required to conduct an unauthorised inspection.
